title: TechnoCraftoMania
description: Hello its Svyatoslav. Its techno modpack. This modpack have big mods (Create, Mekanism). If you find bugs you can write me in discord. Good game:)
body:
# Mods
This modpack add Big mods and addons.
Here mods "Create+Addons" "Mekanism+Addons" "SuperbWarfare" "Applied energistics 2" 60-100 fps if you have good Pc.
**I will add another mods**.
## What i can Do?
Here you can do mekanism, autofarm, factories, ME systems, guns, planes and tanks.
Mekanism for do anothers resurces for reactors, Instruments, armor and autofarms.
Create for do autofarm factories.
Ae2 for youre reasonable composition and autocrafts.
SuperbWarfare for entertainment or war.
### Bugs
If you find bug in mods you can write me in discord. I fix bugs in other modpack update.
**Modpack have bug with server-server.bat, if you do server you need delete sodium because he crash server**
